entries.german:
Zikmund Lucemburský, král římský, uherský, český atd., zastavuje Oldřichu z Rožmberka všechny statky zlatokorunského kláštera v 3 000 kopách grošů českých.

Nos Sigismudus (sic) dei gratia 1 Romanorum rex semper augustus ac Hungariae, Bohemiae, Dalmatiae, Croatiae etc. rex. Memoriae cummendamus (sic) tenore praesentium significantes quibus expedit universis, quod nos matura deliberatione praehabita et ex certa scientia nostrae maiestatis omnia bona monasterii de Corona ubilibet in dicto regno nostro Bohemiae habita, videlicet munitiones, opida et villas simul cum censibus et proventibus iustis et legittimis nec non universis utilitatibus scilicet terris arabilibus, cultis et incultis, silvis, pratis, nemoribus, campis, pascuis, aquis, piscinis, aquarumque decursibus, molendinis, molendinorumque locis et generaliter cunctis utilitatum integritatibus, quovis nominis vocabolo (sic) vocitatis, ad eadem bona de iure spectantibus, pro tribus milibus sexagenis grossorum Bohemicalium, quibus fideli nostro, strennuo ac nobili Vlrico de Rosenbergh ratione expensarum suarum per ipsum ad stipendiarios et familiares suos in servitiis nostris regalibus in extirpatione Wycleffistarum hereticae pravitatis fautorum procedente expositarum, posita et calculata cum eodem ratiocinationem nostram (sic, ratiocinatione nostra), comperimus sibi debitorem obligar 2 maiestatem pignori (sic, pignore?), duximus obligandum ymmo obligamus et inpignoramus per praesentes per eundem Vlricum de Rosonbergh (sic) et suos heredes tenendum possidendum ac cum pleno dominio, nichil inde excipientes, utifruendum tam diu, donec sibi aut suis heredibus per nos aut successores nostros reges utputa Bohemiae vel alios quorum interest seu intererit, dicta tria milia sexagenae grossorum fuerint integraliter persolutae, tali conditione interiecta, ut idem Vlricus de Rosonbergh et sui successores abbati de dicta Corona pro tempore constituto et fratribus claustralibus loci eiusdem victum et amictum et alia necessaria aministrare (!), populosque et villanos in bonis ad dictum monasterium pertinentibus commorantes in antiquis eorum consuetudinibus et libertatibus, quibus ipsi actenus usi fuerunt et gavisi, irrefragabiliter conservare ac tenere, et quamprimo eidem Vlrico de Rosonbergh vel suis heredibus dictae (sic) tria milia sexagenae grossorum per nos vel nostros successores praedictos vel alios quorum interest seu intererit, fuerint persolutae, in continenti sine difficultate et aliquali litigionari 3 processu dicta bona eidem monasterio de Corona remittere et resignare debeat (sic, debeant) et teneantur. Et quis vel qui cum eiusdem Vlrici de Rosonbergh voluntate praesentes litteras habuerit seu habuerint, illi vel illis ius competit omnium praemissorum. Harum nostrarum quibus sigillum nostrum appensum est testimonio litterarum mediante. Datum in civitate nostra Czaslaviensi feria tertia proxima post festum beati Michaelis archangeli, anno domini millesimo quadringentesimo vigesimo, regnorum nostrorum anno Hungariae etc. tricesimo quarto, Romanorum undecimo; Bohemiae vero primo. Am Kopfe der Urkunde links anstatt wie gewöhnlich am Umbug der Urkunde links: Commissio propria domini regis.

entries.english:
Sigismund of Luxembourg, king of the Romans, Hungary, Bohemia and other realms, pledges all the property of Goldenkron monastery to Ulrich von Rosenberg for 3,000 Schock of Bohemian groschen.

We, Siegmund, by the grace of God king of the Romans, ever august, and king of Hungary, Bohemia, Dalmatia, Croatia and other realms, commit to memory and make known by these presents to all whom it may concern that, after mature deliberation and with the certain knowledge of our majesty, we have decided to pledge, and by these presents do pledge, all the property of the monastery of Goldenkron wherever it is held in our kingdom of Bohemia: namely fortifications, towns and villages, together with their just and lawful rents and revenues and all benefits, including cultivated and uncultivated arable land, forests, meadows, groves, fields, pastures, waters, ponds, watercourses, mills and mill sites, and generally all benefits, by whatever name called, lawfully belonging to that property.

The pledge is for 3,000 Schock of Bohemian groschen, which, after an accounting with our faithful, valiant and noble Ulrich von Rosenberg, we have found our majesty owes him for his expenses on his hired soldiers and retainers in our royal service against the Wycliffites, supporters of heretical wickedness. Ulrich and his heirs shall hold, possess and enjoy the property with full lordship, nothing excepted, until the 3,000 Schock of groschen are paid in full to him or his heirs by us, our successors as kings of Bohemia, or others concerned now or in future.

This is subject to the condition that Ulrich and his successors provide food, clothing and other necessities to the current abbot of Goldenkron and the brothers of the monastery, and preserve and maintain the people and villagers living on the monastery's property without infringement in the ancient customs and liberties they have hitherto used and enjoyed. As soon as the 3,000 Schock are paid to Ulrich or his heirs by us, our aforesaid successors or others concerned, they shall immediately return and restore the property to the monastery of Goldenkron without difficulty or any litigation. Whoever holds these letters with Ulrich's consent shall have the rights to all the foregoing.

In testimony of this we issue these letters with our seal attached. Given in our city of Čáslav on the Tuesday next after the feast of St. Michael the Archangel, in the year of the Lord 1420, the thirty-fourth year of our reign over Hungary and our other realms, the eleventh over the Romans and the first over Bohemia.

At the upper left of the charter, instead of the usual position on the left of the fold: “By the king's own command.” One seal hangs from a parchment strip.
